53065.page_note: State-licensed ambulance response areas cover the whole county: Sheriff's Ambulance, Chewelah Rural, Deer Park and Spokane Tribal. No source gives the boundary between the Sheriff's and Chewelah areas. Deer Park Ambulance is the advanced life support transport agency for southern Stevens County (Spokesman-Review, 2026-03-09).
sources: https://www.spokesman.com/stories/2026/mar/09/stevens-county-ambulance-system-continues-to-navig/ ("Stevens County Sheriff's Ambulance and Deer Park Ambulance are the only advanced life support agencies in the county"; Deer Park "is the only advanced life support transport agency in southern Stevens County"; Chewelah Rural named as part of the system, area not described)
https://www.scfpd1.com/ems ("Deer Park Ambulance is our primary ground transport and paramedic agency")
https://services8.arcgis.com/rGGrs6HCnw87OFOT/arcgis/rest/services/Agency_Primary_Response_Area_view/FeatureServer/0 (Spokane Tribal: layer only, AMBV.ES.60448538, no news source)
53065.decision: A kept as state-licensed ambulance response areas (union 99.9%, 4 named) plus two news/agency corroborations; not a dispatch assignment.

53023.page_note: Garfield County Fire District 1 holds the only ambulance licence here (state response area, 99.8% of the county). No source states which agency 911 sends, so this is not confirmed.
sources: https://neris.fsri.org/departments/FD53023779 (949 Main St, Pomeroy, same address as the county resource guide ambulance entry)
53023.decision: Answer kept, tier left at C: licence plus address match only, no source for the 911 assignment.

add.name: Clarkston Fire Department
add.note: City of Clarkston page: one staffed ambulance and three in reserve

53003.page_note: Clarkston Fire Department runs the city ambulance; Asotin County Fire District 1 covers the rest of the county, and Lewiston (Idaho) Fire staffs the rural ambulance under contract. The state lists Clarkston only as an aid service, and the city ambulance funding was in doubt in 2026 (levy result not confirmed), so this stays unconfirmed.
sources: https://www.asotincountywa.gov/AgendaCenter/ViewFile/Minutes/_09152025-344 (Lewiston rural EMS agreement renewal, from a search summary, not opened)
53003.decision: Held at C: Lewiston FD has no polygon, Clarkston is licensed only as an aid service, and the Aug 2026 levy result was not found. Re-check before publishing.

add.name: Columbia County FD #3
add.note: Waitsburg Times 2019-01-31: from Feb. 1 2019 Columbia County Fire District #3 provides BLS ambulance transports for Waitsburg; confirmed again 2022-03-17

53071.page_note: Waitsburg Ambulance stopped in February 2019. Columbia County Fire District 3 now carries basic life support transports for the Waitsburg area and Walla Walla Fire provides advanced life support. Elsewhere the county sends the nearest EMTs and an ambulance together. No state area record, so this stays unconfirmed.
53071.decision: Held at C: the county EMS-levy system is described in news, not a state area record.

53037.decision: Confirmed by the Daily Record (KVFR lower county, Medic One upper county); no change.
